name: Special South Gate City Council
minutes_text:
CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE
  SPECIAL  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY,  DECEMBER  10, 2024

CALL  TO ORJ)ER  Gil Hurtado,  Mayor  called  a Special  City  Council  Meeting  to order at 5:00
  p.m.

ROLL  CALL  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor  Gil Hurtado,  Vice  Mayor  Maria  Davila,  Council  Member  Maria  del
  Pilar Avalos,  Council  Member  Joshua Barron  and Council  Member  Al
  Rios;  City Treasurer  Jose De La Paz, City  Manager  Rob Houston,  City
  Attorney  Rail  F. Salinas

WASTEWATER  MGMT  The City  Council  unanimously  approved  items A, B, C, D, E, F & G by
  motion  of Vice Mayor  Davila  and seconded  by Council  Member  Rios.

  ROLL  CALL:  Council  Member  Avalos,  yes; Council  Member  Rios, yes;
  Vice Mayor  Davila,  yes; Council  Member  Barron,  recused;  Mayor
  Hurtado,  recused.

  a.  Agreement  (Contract  No. 2024-100-CC)  with  Sancon  Technologies
  Inc., for the construction  of the Sewer Pipeline  Lining  Improvements,
  City  Project  No. 709-SWR,  in an amount  not-to-exceed  $2,143,727;

  b.  Authorized  the City  Manager  to administratively  approve  contract
  change  orders  up to a cumulative  amount  of $250,000  to avoid
  delaying  construction  when  change  order work  is needed,  which  will
  be funded  from  project  contingency  funds;

  c.  Approved  Change  Order  No.  I to reduce  the scope of work  and
  $502,368  in cost, which  cost reduction  is in accordance  with  unit bid
  pricing,  as necessary  to complete  the project  within  budget;

  d. Authorized  the City  Manager  to approve  pre-payments  of construction
  progress  payments  to comply  with  State legislation  that requires
  making  payments  within  30 days from  receipt  of an invoice;

  e.  Approved  Notice  of Exemption  for the Sewer Pipeline  Lining  and
  Improvements,  City  Project  No. 709-SWR,  pursuant  to Title  14 of the
  California  Code of Regulations,  Section  15301  Class  I of the
  California  Environmental  Quality  Act ("CEQA");

  f.  Approved  filing  a Categorical  Exclusion  Checklist  with  the
  appropriate  federal  agency  for the Sewer  Pipeline  Lining  and
  Improvements,  City  Project  No. 709-SWR,  pursuant  to the
  requirements  of the National  Environmental  Policy  Act  ("NEPA");  and
   CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING  MINUTES  OF DECEMBER  10, 2024
  SPECIAL

  g.  Authorized  the Mayor  to execute  the Agreement  in a form  acceptable

  to the City Attorney.  r--

  SESSION  The Council  Members  recessed  into Closed  Session  at 5:22 p.m. and
CLOSED

  reconvened  at 6:31 p.m. with  all Members  of Council  present.  City

  Attorney  Salinas  reported  the following:

  1.  CONFERENCE  WITH  LEGAL  COUNSEL  - PENDING
  LITIGATION
  Pursuant  to Government  Code Section  54956.9(a),
  54954.9(b)(3)(C)

  a. Rosa Marquez  v. City  of South  Gate, et al.

  Item  1(a) is a new lawsuit.  There  was a presentation  made by the City
  Attorney  and upon completion  of that presentation,  there was a motion
  made by Vice  Mayor  Davila  and seconded  by Mayor  Hurtado  and on a

  vote of 5-0, authorized  the City Attorney  to represent  the city in that
  matter.

  2.  CONSIDER  THE  EVALUATION  OF PERFORMANCE  OF A

  PUBLIC  EMPLOYEE
  Pursuant  to Government  Code Section  54957  and 54957.6

  .  l

  a.  City  Manager

  On item 2(a), the City  Council  received  a presentation  by the City

  Manager  and at the end of that presentation  there was no action  taken by

  the City  Council.

ADJOURNMENT  Vice Mayor  Davila  unanimously  adjourned  the meeting  at 6:34 p.m. and
  seconded  by Council  Member  Avalos.

PASSED  and APPROVED  on this 28f'l day of January  2025.
